fields.title: Stand-in matches one elastic combination, not complete similarity
fields.evidence: 3.103123575680 mm and yield-demand ratio 0.985992767035 reproduce for the QUESTIONABLE 89.6 MPa tensile proxy. Vc changes from 0.953213852654 to 0.858516900574, biaxial membrane stiffness increases 30.667536%, and the wrinkle margin multiplies by 4.003643932. At 9.318 mm the owner's own core-onset ratio is 1.041532306140, exceeding the text's 'within +2.6%'.
fields.proposed_fix: State these changes and the separate 9.318-mm yield/onset ratios; measure the formed/cured 5052-O compression response before claiming a yield interaction match.

claim: Stand-in matches one elastic combination, not complete similarity
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
